# BtnShade Design Notes & Implementation Tasks

## Overview

Recreation of ColorLib Bootstrap Buttons 11 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/bootstrap-buttons-11/`).
New app name: `btnshade` (package `@free-react-templates/btnshade`).

## Section Breakdown & Structure

1. **Header / Navbar**: Clean minimalist header with brand title ("BtnShade") and navigation links.
2. **Hero / Title Section**: Heading "#01 — Bootstrap 4 Buttons" with brief introduction.
3. **Button Sizes Section**: Large, Medium, Small interactive button specimens.
4. **Comprehensive Color Palette Grid**: 18 distinct color variants (Primary, Secondary, Success, Info, Warning, Danger, Light, Orange, Indigo, Pink, Deep Orange, Aqua, Dark, Black, Purple, Blue, Brown, Blue Gray).
5. **Full-Width Button Section**: Block level full-width button specimen.
6. **Footer**: Clean attribution footer linking to `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock").

## Design Tokens & Styling

- Colors mapped precisely from computed styles of the ColorLib preview.
- Tailwind CSS 4 utility classes with custom theme variables.
- Lucide React icons for interactive UI elements.
